desc: The guided farm tutorial (state: Save.d.tutorial.ft = {did, done, skipped}). Short, one prompt at a time, not skippable on a new save (owner, Nov 3 DECISIONS.md). Every owner-confirmable choice is under 'options' so it is a one-line change.

options.house_cost_in: farm_build.json build.house (a little wood and 8 swings of labour)

options_doc: tracker_replaces_day1: the top-right card is the Goals tracker. player_swing: the interact key near a site swings a hammer (one swing per swing_cooldown_s), so one Boki is enough. end_gems: the one reward at the end (the old +5 each and +30). free_order: after the house is down feed, crop and meet-Hob can come in any order (false: strictly in the listed order). skippable: shows a Skip button (the owner says the farm tutorial cannot be skipped on a new save). free_tools: a step with gives_tool hands that tool over (the axe, the pickaxe); the Market still sells them later. market_gems: the buy step tops the gems up to one seed's price so nobody gets stuck.

hints.go: Here, take this axe. Trees are wood, and wood builds
Swing it at a tree ({interact}). Wood lands in the bar up top, and building eats it

hints.place: Now a house. Press {build}, pick House (a little wood), click the marked spot
hints.wait: Your Boki are on it. Press {interact} at the house to swing a hammer too

hints.go: Grab the hammer: press {interact} at the house and help them swing
Click {boki}, or press {details} beside it, to open its page. The Boki button on the bar below opens it from anywhere
Rocks are stone, for sturdier builds. Take this pickaxe and press {interact} on a rock

hints.place: A hungry Boki is a slow Boki. Press {build} and set the trough down
hints.fill: Fill the trough from your pantry ({interact})

hints.patch: Crops come from patches. Press {build} and set one down by the water: it waters itself
hints.patch_dry: Crops come from patches. Press {build} and set one down (by water it would water itself)
hints.plant: Plant a seed in the patch ({interact})
hints.water: Not by the water? Then water it yourself ({interact})
hints.grow: It takes a moment. Carry on with the rest meanwhile

world.patch: Put the patch by the water

hints.stall: To the market stall ({interact}). Seeds tab, buy one
hints.bar: Open the Market on the bar below. Seeds tab, buy one

hints.stall: Back at the stall ({interact}): Sell tab, sell a crop. Gems come from selling, expeditions and Goals
hints.bar: Open the Market, Sell tab: sell a crop. Gems come from selling, expeditions and Goals

hints.go: Come and have a word ({interact}). I draw up what you can build
This Mask holds a fallen Hunter. Put it on, and you become them. The portal ({interact}) takes you on your first expedition

tracker.title: Goals
tracker.per_source_doc: At most this many rows from each source, so the top five are not all Hunter challenges. Order inside a source: closest to done first; ready-to-claim rows lead everything.

tool_toasts.axe: Someone left a spare axe by the house
tool_toasts.pickaxe: And a pickaxe for the rocks

gems_toast: Hob slips you %d gems for seeds
steps_doc: needs: steps that must be done first; needs_all: everything else; after_built: the house must stand; waits: hint stages that are only waiting (the next open step is shown meanwhile); gives_tool: handed over when the step comes up; gets: a material that finishes the step (detect).
